description: This file declares functions related to logging frontend in Zephyr OS, including initialization, message logging with various argument counts, and panic notification.

methods.name: log_frontend_msg
methods.description: Logs a generic message without timestamp, with detailed parameters for source, descriptor, package, and data.

methods.name: log_frontend_simple_0
methods.description: Logs a message with no arguments, optimized for simple string messages.

methods.name: log_frontend_simple_1
methods.description: Logs a message with one argument fitting in a 32-bit word.

methods.name: log_frontend_simple_2
methods.description: Logs a message with two arguments fitting in 32-bit words.
